title: najas marina subsp. latior
intro: Najas marina subsp. latior, commonly known as the broad-leaved Najas, is a sub-species of aquatic plant belonging to the Najadaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in treating conditions such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Najas marina subsp. latior include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. The bioactive constituents of Najas marina subsp. latior, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
